review.evidence: Ethena x Steakhouse USDC (ethenaUSDC) at base:0xbeeff0be997cca5b1c13a7433c2004637975739e is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x8c47e3c9a99b819222e37b91635bb9fed29c5319 holds 3 enumerated Morpho market IDs. At base block 52095852 (0x31aeb6c), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.793112+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was zero with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation. Independent refinement reproduced exact deployed bytecode equality, owner/curator, all gate addresses and irreversible setters, per-selector delays, and full historical grant-event candidates with active mapping confirmation. Active allocators=0x0000aeb716a0df7a9a1aad119b772644bc089da8,0x1be9b8c406120b2c2b8990d0522cd226a3d60e36,0xaed282b8ad9257bb1272e93ae63a32a53621e412,0xbbf1ad10455eed600cd78a1702f7aca41c9abceb,0xfc580f2a77e85f1f47b60f096d36fdc97ce2d827,0xfeed46c11f57b7126a773eec6ae9ca7ae1c03c9a; active sentinels=. Owner/curator and added Safe rosters, terminating module pages, guards and nonzero fallback handlers are explicitly recorded. This closes role-address/quorum and coarse module-presence census, NOT execution-complete controller/alternate-call reach, custody attestation or financial/insolvency assurance. Independently reproduced functional compiler/runtime correspondence against Sourcify runtimeMatch=match (matchId 30034094, verifiedAt 2026-05-26T22:26:25Z, solc 0.8.28+commit.7893614a, viaIR, optimizer 100000). Only compiler-declared immutable offsets (asset AST37, decimals AST39, virtualShares AST41) and the 11-byte CBOR compiler tag at byte offset 21796 were masked; every remaining executable byte equals the Sourcify recompiled VaultV2 runtime. Each immutable occurrence separately equals this exact deployment asset()/decimals()/virtualShares() getter. Normalized runtime SHA-256=cf17ab0161388ea9277000e692e929216da2618e441c54bcd677def1000dd12e. This is functional source correspondence, not full metadata/creation-bytecode identity or a financial audit. Calibration 2026-10-03 preserves the following observations outside the umbrella census flag: Independent human control and key-custody procedures are not publicly established for the exact listed controller/signing addresses; no custody attestation is inferred from Safe quorum or empty EOA code. | Internal operator/admin and mutable-call target reach of allocator contracts 0x1be9b8c406120b2c2b8990d0522cd226a3d60e36, 0xaed282b8ad9257bb1272e93ae63a32a53621e412 are not execution-complete. Safe fallback handlers are identified but their complete executable noninterference is not certified. | No exact-vault independently signed financial assurance or enforceable statutory holder insolvency priority is established; this separate backing gap is not resolved by the mint-role census. Under calibration rule 3, the recorded none-detected module/guard census and standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler identities do not introduce a separately identified mint path; absence of an execution-complete noninterference certificate remains recorded, not treated as an unidentified authority. Mint-level reconciliation remains not-applicable to the reviewed immutable, deposit/fee-share accounting mechanism; the missing independently signed financial assurance and insolvency priority remain explicit Backing-domain gaps in the existing reserves/mechanism evidence. Known signer/quorum facts receive no inferred custody or human-independence credit. V2 calibration preserves the previous scoped observations and their exact controller references: base:0x1be9b8c406120b2c2b8990d0522cd226a3d60e36: This named allocator role holder is identified in the complete pinned VaultV2 role census, but its internal operator/admin and mutable-call target reach are not execution-complete. Which implementation, administrator and alternate execution targets can exercise this controller's allocation permissions? The uncertainty is local to this controller, not unidentified vault share minters. | base:0xaed282b8ad9257bb1272e93ae63a32a53621e412: This named allocator role holder is identified in the complete pinned VaultV2 role census, but its internal operator/admin and mutable-call target reach are not execution-complete. Which implementation, administrator and alternate execution targets can exercise this controller's allocation permissions? The uncertainty is local to this controller, not unidentified vault share minters. V2 correction: the exact deployment functional runtime equivalence proof closes the VaultV2 mint-code identity gap. Supply is issued by immutable deposit/fee-share accounting; reconciliation remains not-applicable to that mint mechanism and supervision remains none, with no financial-assurance or regulatory-supervision credit inferred. The two named allocator-contract internal operator/admin and mutable-target gaps concern authored parameter-only allocation permissions: verified VaultV2 code prevents them from replacing share mint logic or raising curator caps. These observations remain operational allocation/custody uncertainty, not unresolved mint/upgrade paths. V2 rule 1 records the existing signing-policy/human-independence/key-custody observations on every exact identified Safe/EOA control. No custody attestation or human independence is inferred, and no automatic multisig custody-pricing claim is made.
